statement: Revit 2027 opens a Forma project inside Revit as a connected client (technical preview) to exchange scenarios with the cloud.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Overview

superiority: Work offline with a local copy and sync when connected, which the cloud-only tool does not offer.

acceptance.sketch: Revit session connects to a test Forma project and lists its scenarios.

statement: Browse analysis scenarios and proposals stored in Forma from within Revit.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Scenarios

superiority: Show scenario history and diff in one panel.

acceptance.sketch: Scenario list equals the cloud list.

statement: Bring site context data (terrain, buildings, roads) from Forma into Revit as geolocated reference geometry.

source.ref: Forma Connected Client: Site Context Import
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Site Context Import

superiority: Keep the context live-linked and diffable with a version history.

acceptance.sketch: Imported context aligns to the project location within 1 m.

statement: Bring wind analysis results from Forma as overlays in Revit as part of the initial 2027 integration.

source.ref: Forma Connected Client: Wind Analysis Results
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Wind Analysis Results

superiority: Run a local comparable analysis and show results with transparent assumptions.

acceptance.sketch: Overlay legend values match the Forma result.

statement: Send a building design from Forma to Revit as a geolocated native model.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Geolocated Handoff

superiority: Make the handoff bidirectional so Revit edits flow back.

acceptance.sketch: Handoff model sits at the Forma site coordinates.

statement: Sign in with an Autodesk account and pick a Forma hub and project.

source.ref: Forma Connected Client: Authentication and Projects
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Authentication and Projects

superiority: Offer local-first sign-in with optional cloud.

acceptance.sketch: Signed-in user sees permitted projects only.

statement: Exchange data with Forma through a data exchange service.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Data Exchange

superiority: Open schemas published for every exchange.

statement: Civil 3D is a second connected client following Revit; clients share a common framework for cloud-connected workflows.

source.ref: Forma Connected Client: Connected Client Framework
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Connected Client Framework

superiority: Open connected-client framework for third-party tools.

acceptance.sketch: Two clients receive the same project data.

statement: Access Forma analyses (sun, daylight, wind, noise, carbon) through integration.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Forma Connected Client: Analysis Library

superiority: Run equivalent analyses locally with open data.
